answer: Re-attestations are stored in willow and wharf lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the onyx graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 889 impostors cost 1669 times the honest price and take 17 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
